objective: Persist and enforce stable real-outcome identity for scored Quest v2 creation so retries, renamed quests, and new quest instance IDs cannot accidentally earn progression twice for the same real outcome. When cadence matters, cadence is part of the stable outcome_key rather than a separate mutable identity field.

roles_before.artifact: quest_id uniquely identifies a quest attempt/instance.
system-quest-difficulty:v1 requires an outcome_key and duplicate detection, but the promoted Quest v2 ledger did not persist that key.
system-quest-reward:v1 constrains amounts and progression.award constrains one award per completion basis.
Existing Quest v1/v2 events and unscored quests remain readable and actionable.
system_events is append-only and Neon is the sole mutable owner of derived RPG state.
Production schema/player mutation requires separate exact authorization; candidate work must not change production.
Current main remains exact rollback provenance.

role_dispositions.destination: quest_id remains the unique quest-attempt identity.

New scored Quest v2 creation under system-quest-difficulty:v1 must carry one normalized stable outcome_key. The key is persisted in quest.created; a different quest_id cannot create the same active/completed scored outcome. CANCELLED, FAILED, or EXPIRED unrewarded attempts may retry the same outcome identity.
Existing reward calibration, verified completion, atomic quest.resolve, and one-award-per-completion rules remain unchanged.
Historical events without outcome_key remain valid; generic/unscored/legacy quest creation remains supported.
No updates/deletes or second state owner; migration 008 adds one lookup index, one validation trigger/function, and one scored-quest wrapper over the existing system_apply_action gate.

Candidate branch, CI, and a disposable Neon child branch are allowed verification surfaces. Promotion would apply migration 008 to production and therefore remains blocked pending separate exact authorization. No player-state write is authorized.
Base SHA 882bcf090de27b7608733bb925b674ec12494974 remains the exact rollback point until an authorized promotion.

capability_probes.assertion: Existing unscored and legacy quest.create behavior remains accepted.
A new scored Quest v2 under system-quest-difficulty:v1 cannot be created without a normalized outcome_key.
A second scored Quest v2 with a different quest_id but the same active/completed outcome_key is rejected before rewardable state is created.
An EXPIRED/FAILED/CANCELLED unrewarded attempt may retry the same outcome_key without minting a new outcome identity.
quest.resolve atomic completion/reward tests and existing HTTP-through-PostgreSQL behavior remain green.
The exact base SHA preserves the pre-outcome-key runtime and all historical player data remains readable.

tests.expected: New difficulty-managed scored Quest v2 persists outcome_key, missing keys fail closed, active/completed duplicates are rejected, and terminal unrewarded retries are accepted.
PostgreSQL migration 008 and the scored-quest wrapper enforce the same outcome identity semantics without changing progression totals during the shared regression suite.

tests.command: Apply migration 008 only to disposable Neon child branch system-outcome-key-v1-test; create one keyed scored quest; reject a second active duplicate; terminate an expired probe; accept a same-key retry after expiry.
